title: Act: Scaffold worker Go module and YAML config
summary: Create worker LoadFS config for repo/worktree/agent/timeout, example YAML, stub entry in root Go module.
description:
Context: No worker sources exist; root go.mod exists after ACT-BE.
Desired behavior: Add worker YAML config fields required by REQ-WORKER and a stub that only loads config.
Expected result: Worker configures paths/commands without invoking Claude CLI.
Why: Implements REQ-WORKER product code only.
acceptance_criteria: Given Act complete, when inspecting the root, then worker.go, worker_config.go, and worker.config.example.yaml exist.
Given example-shaped YAML, when LoadWorkerFS reads it, then RepoPath, WorktreeDir, Agent.Command, and Execution.TimeoutSeconds populate.
definition_of_done: No test files added by this Act

steps.action: Create WorkerConfig with RepoPath string yaml:"repo_path", WorktreeDir string yaml:"worktree_dir", Agent struct{Command string yaml:"command"} yaml:"agent", Execution struct{TimeoutSeconds int yaml:"timeout_seconds"} yaml:"execution". Export LoadWorkerFS(fsys fs.FS, name string) (*WorkerConfig, error) decoding YAML and returning error if RepoPath empty, Agent.Command empty, or TimeoutSeconds <= 0. Package main.
steps.expected: LoadWorkerFS validates required config fields via fs.FS.

steps.action: Create example YAML with repo_path ., worktree_dir .worktrees, agent.command claude, execution.timeout_seconds 3600.
steps.code:
repo_path: "."
worktree_dir: ".worktrees"
agent:
  command: claude
execution:
  timeout_seconds: 3600
steps.expected: Example worker YAML documents required keys.

steps.action: Create runWorker(cfgPath string) int that calls LoadWorkerFS(os.DirFS("."), cfgPath), prints repo_path and agent.command, returns 0 on success / 1 on error. Do not exec the agent command. Package main.
steps.expected: Worker stub loads config without invoking external agents.

steps.action: Update main to accept -mode flag default server; when mode is worker, call os.Exit(runWorker(*cfgPath)) before server path; keep existing server LoadFS path for mode server.
steps.code:
before: only server LoadFS path
after: mode := flag.String("mode", "server", "server|worker"); if *mode == "worker" { os.Exit(runWorker(*cfgPath)) } then existing server path
steps.expected: main supports -mode=worker without listening or invoking Claude CLI.
